scope: Debug production components, offline fixtures, fresh process per fixture, 3 repetitions; not Release FPS
clipboard_validation: Capturing LocalClipboard verifies production action payloads; ROM read permission module prevents ordinary clipboard readback. Production uses platform LocalClipboard.
limits: Static standard layout and solid/hidden bubbles only; streaming-in-session and other materials use legacy renderer.
Adjacent safe units packed to at most 8 units and 1024 UTF-16 chars; larger atoms remain whole.
Complete AST and source remain in memory; lazy composition is not data eviction.
Simple prose P95 may regress; compare original and recheck cohorts independently, not pooled.
Android per-frame deadlines vary despite the same reported 60Hz; preserve their distributions.
Heap peaks are sparse workload samples; PSS and selection memory are endpoints without forced GC.
Ordinary long range dragging retains selected lazy items; only source-backed Select All releases pins.
Source-backed Select All copies original Markdown; local drag copies rendered text; no reverse source mapping.
StateRestorationTester recreation is covered, not a full OS process-death experiment.
No model requests, personal chat fixtures, true network images/KaTeX stress or Release performance.
